retirement_age.notes: Differs by cohort since the social insurance amendments of 3 July 2024: new labour-market entrants after that date retire at 65; existing contributors under 50 Hijri years with under 20 years of contributions move gradually within a 58-65 (Gregorian) range; other existing contributors keep the earlier age of 60 Hijri years (about 58 years 3 months Gregorian). statutory is set to the highest value (65).

open_questions: No scheduled national election for head of state, head of government or a national legislature was found in this run's sources; the offices are not filled by election, so the date is left null.

Retirement age: several secondary sources report 60 for men and 55 for women under the older GOSI rules; this was not confirmed against GOSI or the Civil Retirement Law text, and the 2024 amendments appear to replace it with the cohort-based rules in the notes. Verify on gosi.gov.sa.

Population 35,300,280 (2024, World Bank WDI, matching the GASTAT mid-year estimate) was found on a secondary site (demographer.org). UN WPP shows 34.6 million for 2025; the GASTAT primary page was not retrieved.
Median age 29.7 (2026) is a UN WPP 2024-based figure via Worldometer; no GASTAT median age was retrieved.
The King and the Prime Minister hold office without a fixed term, so term_ends is null for both.
